```prolog
% Define the predicate for storing prayer times.
prayerTime(Governorate, Date, Prayer, Time) :-
    % Simulate prayer times for all governorates and dates for the entire year.
    % For simplicity, we're generating mock prayer times here.
    % In a real-world scenario, you'd replace this with actual data.
    generatePrayerTimes(Governorate, Date, Prayer, Time).

% Helper predicate to generate mock prayer times.
generatePrayerTimes(Governorate, Date, Prayer, Time) :-
    Governorates = ['Giza', 'Cairo', 'Alexandria', 'Suez'],
    member(Governorate, Governorates),
    isValidDate(Date),
    split_string(Date, "-", "", [MonthStr, DayStr]),
    string_to_int(MonthStr, Month),
    string_to_int(DayStr, Day),
    random_between(5, 20, Hour),
    random_between(0, 59, Minute),
    format_time(Time, Hour, Minute),
    (
        (Prayer = 'Fajr', Hour >= 5, Hour < 7) ;
        (Prayer = 'Sunrise', Hour >= 6, Hour < 8) ;
        (Prayer = 'Dhuhr', Hour >= 11, Hour < 14) ;
        (Prayer = 'Asr', Hour >= 13, Hour < 16) ;
        (Prayer = 'Maghrib', Hour >= 17, Hour < 19) ;
        (Prayer = 'Isha', Hour >= 18, Hour < 21)
    ).

% Helper predicate to format time as HH:MM.
format_time(Time, Hour, Minute) :-
    format(string(Time), "~2d:~2d", [Hour, Minute]).

% Helper predicate to check if a date is valid.
isValidDate(Date) :-
    split_string(Date, "-", "", [MonthStr, DayStr]),
    string_to_int(MonthStr, Month),
    string_to_int(DayStr, Day),
    Month >= 1, Month =< 12,
    Day >= 1, Day =< daysInMonth(Month, 2023).  % Assuming a non-leap year for simplicity

% Helper predicate to determine the number of days in a month.
daysInMonth(Month, Year, Days) :-
    (
        (Month = 2, leapYear(Year), Days = 29) ;  % Leap year
        (Month = 2, Days = 28) ;  % Non-leap year
        (Month in [4, 6, 9, 11], Days = 30) ;
        (Days = 31)
    ).

% Predicate to check if a year is a leap year.
leapYear(Year) :-
    (Year mod 400 =:= 0 ; (Year mod 4 =:= 0, Year mod 100 \=:= 0)).

% Predicate to get the prayer time for a specific governorate on a specific date.
getPrayerTime(Governorate, Date, Prayer, Time) :-
    isValidDate(Date),
    prayerTime(Governorate, Date, Prayer, Time).

getPrayerTime(_, _, _, "Invalid date") :-
    !.

% Predicate to get the minimum and maximum Isha prayer times for a governorate.
getMinMaxIsha(Governorate, MinTime, MaxTime) :-
    findall(Time, (prayerTime(Governorate, _, 'Isha', Time), string_to_time(Time, T)), Times),
    sort(Times, SortedTimes),
    (
        SortedTimes = [MinTime | _], SortedTimes = [_ | Rest], Rest = [MaxTime | _];
        SortedTimes = [MinTime], MinTime = MaxTime
    ).

getMinMaxIsha(_, "No data", "No data").

% Helper predicate to convert time string to integer minutes since midnight.
string_to_time(String, Time) :-
    sub_string(String, 0, 2, _, HStr),
    sub_string(String, 3, 2, _, MStr),
    string_to_int(HStr, H),
    string_to_int(MStr, M),
    Time is H * 60 + M.

% Predicate to list all governorates.
listGovernorates(List) :-
    Governorates = ['Giza', 'Cairo', 'Alexandria', 'Suez'],
    List = Governorates.

% Example usage

% ?- getMinMaxIsha('Giza', MinTime, MaxTime).
% ?- listGovernorates(List).
```
